this one can and that one cannot -- all agree: liable
the baraita: one who carries out a loaf to the public domain is liable
two carried it out -- R' Meir obligates

'when he does it' (Lev 4:27) -- one who does all of it, not one who does part of it

two holding a shuttle and weaving -- [not liable]

three exclusions are written: 'a person sins', 'one sins', 'when he does it sins'

one excludes this one can and that one can
one excludes this one cannot and that one cannot
